description: The line plot illustrates the Micro F1 (%) performance of KnowPrompt when trained with varying numbers of samples generated by large language models (LLMs), as evaluated across four different methods: TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, Re-TACRED, and SemEval. The x-axis represents the "Number of Samples Generated," with values at K=8, K=16, K=32, and K=64, indicating the scale of generated data. The y-axis shows the Micro F1 (%) score, ranging from 25 to 55. The TACRED method (blue line with circular markers) shows a steady increase from approximately 23.1% at K=8 to 29.5% at K=64. The TACRED-Revisit method (orange line with triangular markers) exhibits a similar trend, rising from about 23.5% to 30.1%. The Re-TACRED method (green line with diamond markers) demonstrates a more pronounced increase, starting at 34.8% and peaking at 50.8% at K=32 before slightly decreasing to 47.9% at K=64. The SemEval method (red line with square markers) shows a consistent upward trend from 42.0% at K=8 to 52.3% at K=64. Overall, all methods improve with more samples, but Re-TACRED and SemEval achieve significantly higher F1 scores, with Re-TACRED peaking at the highest value.
